# Enrique Escalante

> Enrique Escalante is an economist. He is Associate Professor of Economics at the Norris-Vincent College of Business, Angelo State University (San Angelo, Texas), and Research Associate Professor at the Free Market Institute, Texas Tech University. He holds a Ph.D. from the Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics at Texas Tech University. His research is on the political economy of violence and development: political conflict (Peru's insurgencies and community self-defense), political regimes and growth (Chile), and the institutions behind state and fiscal capacity, with a focus on Latin America.

Methods: ethnographic fieldwork and case studies combined with quantitative approaches, including natural experiments, synthetic control and difference-in-differences. Before graduate school he founded and directed Andes Libres, an educational think tank in Cusco, Peru. He speaks to public audiences in English and Spanish.

## Selected publications

- "The Odd Couple: Formal and Informal Governance in the Making of Fiscal Capacity", Journal of Comparative Economics, forthcoming
- "Friends or Foes? The Insurgent's Dilemma of Seeking Legitimacy While Keeping Secrets", World Development, 2026 ([summary](https://enriqueescalante.com/friends-or-foes/))
- "Por la Razón o la Fuerza: What Caused Chile's Economic Miracle?", in The Pinochet Shock, Palgrave Macmillan, 2025
- "A Self-Defense Network against Terrorism and Crime: Evidence from Peru", Terrorism and Political Violence, 2023 ([summary](https://enriqueescalante.com/self-defense-network/))
- "The Influence of Pinochet in the Chilean Miracle", Latin American Research Review, 2022 ([summary](https://enriqueescalante.com/pinochet/))
- "Night Watchers and Terrorists", Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization, 2020 ([summary](https://enriqueescalante.com/nightwatchers/))
- "Fighting on Christmas: Brawling as Self-Governance in Rural Peru" (with Raymond March), Journal of Institutional Economics, 2020 ([summary](https://enriqueescalante.com/takanakuy/))
